name: lumi-skill-stockbot
description: Chinese A-stock market assistant — quotes, watchlists, intraday alerts, K-lines, indices, sectors, news, risk-managed trade planning, and paper trading. Data sourced from public market endpoints with fallback quote providers.

lumi.setupNote: Free data from public exchanges. No API key needed. Stock watching, trade planning, alerts, and paper trading are for learning and simulation only, not investment advice or real order placement.
